import os

from cyhole.solscan import SolscanV2
from cyhole.solscan.v2.interaction import SolscanClient

api_key = os.getenv("SOLSCAN_API_KEY")
if not api_key:
    raise ValueError("SOLSCAN_API_KEY environment variable not set")

solscan = SolscanV2(api_key=api_key)
client = SolscanClient(interaction=solscan)

token_address = "EPjFWaLb3hyccqJ1xNg5Fc2JgShE1ZznC3gAoVAau64d"

end_time = datetime.now()
start_time = end_time - timedelta(days=7)

response = client.get_token_price(token=token_address, time_range=(start_time, end_time))

print(response)
